svg.text: py-spy record -o /h/flames-combo/TP05_charts.svg --rate 50 --nonblocking -- python3 -c from openpyxl import load_workbook wb = load_workbook('output/monthly_operations_report.xlsx', data_only=False) for s in wb.sheetnames: if wb[s]._charts: print(s, len(wb[s]._charts)) ws_r = wb['Reconciliation'] for ref in ['B10','B14','B5','B24','B25']: c = ws_r[ref] print(ref, c.font.name, c.number_format) ws_raw = wb['Raw_Sample'] print('raw', ws_raw.max_row, ws_raw.max_column) wb.close()
